what_makes_it_work: A number in the title promises a clear finish, and the 'mistake N' label makes each slide a standalone, easy-to-share unit. Several different keyword offers appear along the way, so there are many chances to comment.
lumebook_takeaway: A '9 mistakes' list with one identical layout per slide and a keyword offer on every few slides is easy to produce at scale.
